How was this sort of change in behavior approved during the beta to GA promotion? This is not at all the same behavior that we had in previous minors. There is no user-facing change notice, and the issue justifying it is completely empty of a problem description.

@brandond this change has nothing to do with KMSv2's beta to GA graduation (the title just helps with project board automation).  It applies to the encryption config, which has been GA for a long time.  We moved the logic to polling because there were variations on file changes (like symlink swapping of directories that contain the encryption config) that the file watch logic would fail to detect.  Polling at a set interval prevents any such issues.  There was never any guarantee on how quickly the API server would update the encryption config.

@enj, I agree it would be helpful to add a description to the issue (and a release note in the PR, which means patching the release note doc at this point) giving the rationale and the correct way to determine when a new config has become effective (the `apiserver_encryption_config_controller_automatic_reload_last_timestamp_seconds` metric).

issue_context.title: [KMSv2] Move automatic reload to use a simple one minute poll
issue_context.body: Move the logic to polling because there are variations on file changes (like symlink swapping of directories that contain the encryption config) that the file watch logic would fail to detect. Polling at a set interval prevents any such issues. There was never any guarantee on how quickly the API server would update the encryption config, and the `apiserver_encryption_config_controller_automatic_reload_last_timestamp_seconds` metric correctly identifies when the new config becomes effective.
comments: Check https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/114999 after this implementation is complete

I'm curious how this feature was completely reworked during the promotion to GA, without any justification whatsoever. Literally an empty issue. 

We'd been using this in previous releases relying on the inotify-based reload, just to find that when it went GA it was redone to poll at 1 minute intervals - which is not AT ALL the same behavior that was present in earlier releases.
